{{Quote|Please, you must lift off now! There's more at stake here than you realize. Here's another 500 credits for your trouble. We'll cover you, but go! Go!|Thadius Black|<ref name="Infiltration (RPG adventure)">{{WEGCite|story=Infiltration (adventure)|book=Supernova (sourcebook)}}</ref>}}
'''Thadius Black''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living on [[Demophon]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was late middle-aged and directed a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] components firm. When he saw political prisoners being mistreated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], his compassion led him to attempt to smuggle them off-world during a mass evacuation of Demophon. While he was successful, he was arrested in [[Selkren]] by the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] and held in the [[ISB headquarters office]]. He was later rescued and escaped to [[Mowgle]] with the political prisoners. Thadius Black was married to [[Kymber Black]], with whom he had one son. [[Perth]] was his father.<ref name="I" />
